properties.name: logged.threshold.warnMs
properties.description: Global latency threshold in milliseconds; < 0 disables.

properties.name: logged.threshold.promoteLevel
properties.description: Level to promote when the threshold is exceeded.

properties.name: logged.useIconTheme
properties.description: When true, use a predefined icon theme for call/return/exception/depth icons.

properties.name: logged.iconTheme
properties.description: Predefined icon theme to use when logged.useIconTheme=true.

properties.name: logged.enabled
properties.description: Enable the @Logged engine.

properties.name: logged.announceLoad
properties.description: Log a banner when the engine and plugins load.

properties.name: logged.color
properties.description: Use colored log decorator.

properties.name: logged.icons
properties.description: Enable icon rendering in templates.

properties.name: logged.useUtf8
properties.description: Enable UTF-8 on System.out for pretty symbols. Opt-in: replaces System.out and System.err JVM-wide.

properties.name: logged.redactMask
properties.description: Mask string used when masking values.

properties.name: logged.maskLength
properties.description: Length of the mask string used in output.

properties.name: logged.maskPatterns
properties.description: Global regex patterns to trigger masking on args/return values.

properties.name: logged.maskTypeNames
properties.description: Fully-qualified class names to trigger masking when assignable.

properties.name: logged.failOnInvalidMaskPatterns
properties.description: Fail startup if any mask pattern is invalid.

properties.name: logged.failOnUnresolvedMaskTypes
properties.description: Fail startup if any mask type cannot be resolved.

properties.name: logged.maskReturn
properties.description: Mask return values globally (can be overridden per method).

properties.name: logged.callIcon
properties.description: Icon/string shown on method call messages.

properties.name: logged.returnIcon
properties.description: Icon/string shown on method return messages.

properties.name: logged.exceptionIcon
properties.description: Icon/string shown on exception messages.

properties.name: logged.depthIcon
properties.description: Icon/string used to render depth/indentation.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.enabled
properties.description: Enable the SLF4J plugin.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.color
properties.description: Enable color decoration in SLF4J plugin.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.iconColors
properties.description: Colorize icons separately in SLF4J output.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.callMsgNoArgs
properties.description: Template used on method entry without arguments.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.callMsgArgs
properties.description: Template used on method entry with arguments.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.returnMsg
properties.description: Template used on method return without return value.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.argsTemplate
properties.description: Template for individual arguments when building {a}.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.returnMsgValue
properties.description: Template used on method return with return value.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.exceptionMsg
properties.description: Template used on exceptions.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.timeTakenMsg
properties.description: Template appended when timing is enabled.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.logDepth
properties.description: Render visual depth/indentation in messages.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.captureFromMdc
properties.description: MDC keys to capture as tokens {mdc.<key>} in messages.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.markers
properties.description: Extra markers to attach to SLF4J events.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.maxValueLength
properties.description: Max characters for values (args/return) used by SLF4J plugin.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.captureFromOtel
properties.description: OTel attributes to capture (if available).

properties.name: logged.slf4j.keyValue
properties.description: Emit key-values to logging event where supported.

properties.name: logged.slf4j.keyValues
properties.description: Tokens to emit as key-values in the logging event.

properties.name: logged.mdc.enabled
properties.description: Enable the MDC plugin.

properties.name: logged.mdc.argsTemplate
properties.description: Template for MDC-printed argument rendering.

properties.name: logged.mdc.addMark
properties.description: Add a constant key/value mark into MDC during execution.

properties.name: logged.mdc.markerKey
properties.description: MDC key for the constant mark.

properties.name: logged.mdc.markerValue
properties.description: MDC value for the constant mark.

properties.name: logged.mdc.maxValueLength
properties.description: Max characters for values placed into MDC.

properties.name: logged.otel.enabled
properties.description: Enable the OpenTelemetry plugin.

properties.name: logged.otel.addSourceLine
properties.description: Add source file and line number to span attributes when available.

properties.description: Add class name to span attributes.

properties.name: logged.otel.addMethod
properties.description: Add method name to span attributes.

properties.name: logged.otel.addDepth
properties.description: Add call depth to span attributes.

properties.name: logged.otel.addArgs
properties.description: Add argument names/count to span attributes.

properties.name: logged.otel.addReturnType
properties.description: Add return type info to span attributes on return.

properties.description: Include exception.toString() when setting ERROR status.

properties.description: MDC key name for the span identifier.

properties.description: Template used to build span names.
